<thought>Based on the observed [M+H]⁺ at m/z 121.05 (neutral mass ≈ 120 Da) and the ¹H NMR showing only the five aromatic protons of a monosubstituted benzene, the most consistent structure is acetophenone (phenyl‑CO‑CH₃). Its formula C₈H₈O gives a calculated [M+H]⁺ of 121.064 Da, matching the experimental value within typical instrumental error, and its ¹H NMR would display the observed aromatic signals plus a methyl singlet (which may not have been reported). The SMILES for acetophenone is “CC(=O)c1ccccc1”.</thought>
<final_answer>CC(=O)c1ccccc1</final_answer>
